method: Snapshot modules loaded through in-memory data URLs; Three objects constructed without WebGL/DOM. Three Texture stubs preserve metadata only; no pixel render or visual angle validation performed.
state: Constructor neutral/manual, grounded with pelvis -0.012. Bind matrices are separately retained; current bone poses must not be mistaken for original bind rest.

hair.technique: Continuous 3D scalp and rounded posterior volume, source-pixel curved locks with lenticular cross-sections and damped tip deformation
limitations: The cropped crown and hidden scalp are inferred geometry.
Long curls and ahoge are traced from the approved auxiliary neutral-front image; left curls are mirrored on the right.
Side/back painting remains a structural study, not a final authored turnaround.

structure.posterior: closed curved elliptical volume joining the scalp at the equator
structure.headband: rounded XY arch with front/back depth around z=0
structure.rearTexture: turnaround-auxiliary-v2.png: blue rear-head pixels only, y100–370; no clothing bow
limitations: Rear painting is inferred auxiliary art.
Lower rear flow stretches the safe blue region; it is not an authored final back view.
